description: This PHP class implements a Memcached cache store plugin for delivery cache in the Revive Adserver project. It includes methods for retrieving plugin name, checking cache server status, deleting cache files, and flushing the cache.

classes.name: Plugins_DeliveryCacheStore_oxMemcached_oxMemcached
classes.description: A PHP class providing Memcached-based delivery cache storage functionalities, including status checks and cache management.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the plugin, translated as 'memcached'.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Checks the status of the Memcached server setup, including extension availability, server list validity, expiration time, and server connectivity.

methods.name: _deleteCacheFile
methods.description: Deletes a specific cache entry identified by filename from Memcached.

methods.name: _deleteAll
methods.description: Deletes all cache entries from Memcached.
